summary: This P&ID sheet details the piping and instrumentation for the 20-PA001 separator pump within a production separation and stabilization system. Its purpose is to illustrate the control and safety logic associated with the pump's operation and its connection to upstream separation and downstream condensate export.
main_hazards: Overpressure (indicated by multiple pressure instruments with alarms)
High temperature (indicated by temperature instruments with alarms and a pump trip interlock)
Loss of containment (inherent to hydrocarbon processing)
Loss of flow/cavitation (related to pump operation and flow control)
